"""Publish the combined update evidence, then retire only verified closed-job artifacts."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl, hashlib, importlib.util, json, traceback

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/sync-latest-updates-20261012')
F = W / 'bench/results/2026-10-12-latest-updates-consolidated'
MF = W / 'bench/results/2026-10-12-upstream-monitor-cache'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('update_final_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
L = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint')
ENV = dict(PATH=str(L / 'venv/bin') + ':' + str(L / 'bin') + ':/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi',
           LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8', GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0', GIT_SSH_COMMAND='ssh -o BatchMode=yes')
old = json.loads((B / 'latest-update-main-finalization-host-root-v8/record.json').read_text())
ENV.update({k: old['environment'][k] for k in ('RUBYLIB', 'GEM_PATH')})
def ident(path):
    return dict(path=str(path), sha256=m.sha(path), bytes=path.stat().st_size)
def normalize(v):
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        import re
        return {k: {'sha256': x} if k != 'sha256' and isinstance(x, str) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', x)
                else normalize(x) for k, x in v.items()}
    if isinstance(v, list):
        return [normalize(x) for x in v]
    return v

with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-update-finalization-root-v2'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, commands=[], gpu_executed=False,
             source=ident(Path(__file__)), environment=ENV)
    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    def run(label, args, allowed=(0,), cwd=W):
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, args, ENV, cwd, wall=180, cpu=600, rss_cap=8 << 30,
                             text_cap=32 << 20, total_cap=96 << 20, file_cap=64 << 20)
        r.setdefault('evidence', {})[label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed, label
        return so.read_text().strip()
    try:
        assert run('source-head', ['/usr/bin/git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']) == '440e0851589161a4717f868b2e2d5286ecbab4ff'
        cpu = json.loads((B / 'main-update-monitor-cpu-root-v4/record.json').read_text())
        assert cpu['passed'] and cpu['complete'] and not cpu['active']
        assert all(m.sha(W / p) == h for p, h in cpu['source_pins'].items())
        packet = F / 'finalization-controller.json'
        packet.write_text(json.dumps(dict(identity=ident(Path(__file__)), source=Path(__file__).read_text()), indent=2) + '\n')
        files = [str(p.relative_to(W)) for p in sorted(F.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()]
        run('final-report-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', *files])
        doc_files = ['docs/DEVTOOLS.ja.md', 'docs/DEVTOOLS.md']
        mw = W.parent / 'sync-v0143-monitor-cache-20261012'
        before = run('baseline-devtools-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', *doc_files], (0, 1), mw)
        after = run('candidate-devtools-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', *doc_files], (0, 1))
        import re
        def findings(text):
            return sorted(line for line in text.splitlines() if re.match(r'^docs/[^:]+:[0-9]+: ', line))
        assert findings(before) == findings(after)
        assert 'skipped (' not in before + after and 'possible secret' not in before + after
        r['documentation_lints'] = dict(baseline=findings(before), candidate=findings(after), added=[])
        save()
        run('diff-check', ['/usr/bin/git', 'diff', '--check'])
        run('stage-evidence-docs', ['/usr/bin/git', 'add', '--', str(F.relative_to(W)), 'docs/DEVTOOLS.ja.md', 'docs/DEVTOOLS.md'])
        run('commit-evidence', ['/usr/bin/git', 'commit', '-m', 'docs(bench): record latest update integration and profiling calibration'])
        r['evidence_commit'] = run('evidence-head', ['/usr/bin/git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
        run('push-evidence', ['/usr/bin/git', 'push', 'origin', 'sync/latest-updates-20261012'])

        # Only receipts from the named, fully closed jobs are eligible. Source/models/tool installations remain.
        roots = [B / name for name in (
            'main-update-recheck-integration-root-v1', 'main-update-recheck-server-cpu-root-v1',
            'main-update-recheck-server-lints-root-v1', 'main-update-recheck-merge-publication-root-v1',
            'main-update-recheck-merge-publication-root-v2', 'main-update-monitor-web-tools-root-v1',
            'main-update-monitor-lints-root-v1', 'main-update-monitor-lints-root-v2',
            'main-update-monitor-lints-root-v3', 'main-update-monitor-lints-root-v4',
            'main-update-monitor-cpu-root-v4', 'main-update-monitor-publication-root-v1')]
        roots += [B / f'main-prefill-leaf-service-calibration-root-v1/sample-{n}-profile-{arm}/xe-timed1-on'
                  for n, arm in ((1, 0), (2, 1), (3, 1), (4, 0))]
        preserved = json.loads((F / 'profiling-calibration.json').read_text())
        planned = {}
        for root in roots:
            rp = root / 'record.json'
            v = json.loads(rp.read_text())
            assert not v['active'] and all(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] for c in v['commands']), root
            for command in v['commands']:
                for owned in command.get('owners', []):
                    proc = Path('/proc') / str(owned['pid']) / 'stat'
                    if proc.exists():
                        stat = proc.read_text().rsplit(')', 1)[1].split()
                        assert int(stat[19]) != owned['start_ticks'], ('closed owner still live', owned)
                for name, info in command['logs'].items():
                    matches = [p for p in (root / name, root / 'commands' / name) if p.is_file()]
                    assert len(matches) == 1, (root, name)
                    p = matches[0]
                    assert m.sha(p) == info['sha256'] and p.stat().st_size == info['bytes']
                    planned[str(p)] = dict(original=ident(p), allocated_bytes=p.stat().st_blocks * 512,
                                           reason='Closed raw command text: exact status/ownership/source/recipe and individual outcome or verified aggregate are committed; no complete-history consumer remains.', deleted=False)
            if 'calibration_sample' in v:
                sample = next(s for s in preserved['individual_samples'] if s['calibration_sample'] == v['calibration_sample'])
                assert sample['original']['sha256'] == m.sha(rp)
                assert sample['passed'] == v['passed'] and sample['complete'] == v['complete'] and sample['active'] == v['active']
                assert sample['validation']['output_ids'] == v['validation']['output_ids']
                for key in ('engine_prefill_ms', 'engine_decode_ms', 'token_logprob_lines'):
                    assert sample['validation'][key] == v['validation'][key]
                planned[str(rp)] = dict(original=ident(rp), allocated_bytes=rp.stat().st_blocks * 512,
                                        reason='Original calibration JSON duplicates committed exact sample status/recipe, output, fault/closure evidence and verified leaf aggregates. Future comparison reads profiling-calibration.json.', deleted=False)
                tokens = root / 'tokens.txt'
                canonical = B / 'main-decode-criticalpath-model-root-v1/xe-timed1-on/tokens.txt'
                assert tokens.is_file() and canonical.is_file() and m.sha(tokens) == m.sha(canonical)
                planned[str(tokens)] = dict(original=ident(tokens), allocated_bytes=tokens.stat().st_blocks * 512,
                                            reason='Duplicate32K token fixture; canonical committed-input consumer fixture remains untouched.', deleted=False)
        tools = B / 'main-update-monitor-web-tools-root-v1'
        for p in [*sorted((tools / 'npm-cache').rglob('*')), *sorted(tools.glob('*.deb'))]:
            if p.is_file():
                planned[str(p)] = dict(original=ident(p), allocated_bytes=p.stat().st_blocks * 512,
                                       reason='Closed developer-tool download/cache; installed verified tools, package lock, versions and authenticated package identities remain current lint consumers.', deleted=False)
        manifest = F / 'retention.json'
        def persist():
            manifest.write_text(json.dumps(dict(evidence_commit=r['evidence_commit'], files=list(planned.values()),
                removed_logical_bytes=sum(x['original']['bytes'] for x in planned.values() if x['deleted']),
                removed_allocated_bytes=sum(x['allocated_bytes'] for x in planned.values() if x['deleted']),
                active_runs_touched=False, source_models_services_gpu_state_touched=False,
                retained_original_receipts='Non-calibration structured originals remain byte-identical for existing source/lint receipt pins; next review is the cohort validation boundary.',
                retained_tools='Current mandatory web lints consume installed tools and package-lock; downloaded archives/cache have no consumer.',
                next_tuning_source='sync/latest-updates-20261012; unqualified native Copy2D source and physical262144/RESTORE remain separate work.'), indent=2) + '\n')
        persist()
        for item in planned.values():
            p = Path(item['original']['path'])
            assert m.sha(p) == item['original']['sha256']
            p.unlink()
            item['deleted'] = True
            persist()
        for p in sorted((tools / 'npm-cache').rglob('*'), key=lambda p: len(p.parts), reverse=True):
            if p.is_dir():
                p.rmdir()
        (tools / 'npm-cache').rmdir()
        r['removed_logical_bytes'] = sum(v['original']['bytes'] for v in planned.values())
        r['removed_allocated_bytes'] = sum(v['allocated_bytes'] for v in planned.values())
        run('retention-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', str(manifest.relative_to(W))])
        run('stage-retention', ['/usr/bin/git', 'add', '--', str(manifest.relative_to(W))])
        run('commit-retention', ['/usr/bin/git', 'commit', '-m', 'chore(bench): retire closed update and calibration duplicates'])
        r['final_commit'] = run('final-head', ['/usr/bin/git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
        run('push-retention', ['/usr/bin/git', 'push', 'origin', 'sync/latest-updates-20261012'])
        assert not run('final-status', ['/usr/bin/git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        r['complete'] = True
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
        r['traceback'] = traceback.format_exc()
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        r['passed'] = bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'))
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ('passed', 'complete', 'error', 'evidence_commit', 'final_commit', 'removed_logical_bytes')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
